chunks: Ahmad ibn Harun al-Fami - may God be pleased with him - narrated that him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Ja'far ibn Batta narrated that Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahboob narrated from Ibrahim ibn Hashem from Soleiman ibn Hafs al-Marvazi who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him)
He said: My son Ali will be killed by poison unjustly and buried next to Harun in Toos. Whoever visits him is like whoever visits the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family).

key_terms.هَارُونَ: Harun (Harun ibn Muhammad, father of al-Ma'mun)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of visiting Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha's shrine in Toos according to Imam Musa ibn Ja'far?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *‘Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the prophetic status of Imam al-Rida (a.s.) by equating the spiritual reward of visiting his shrine with that of the Prophet Muhammad (s.a.w.w.), a unique distinction in Shia tradition. It specifically notes his burial in Toos adjacent to the Abbasid Caliph Harun al-Rashid, symbolizing the triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt over their oppressors even in death. The narration underscores the theological concept of *Ziyarah* as a means of connecting with the divine authority (*Hujjah*) present in the Imams.
